events.body:
## Context

BLT-Nexus (`blt-nexus/`) is rated **Bronze** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-nexus): it meets 79% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Bronze (the basics: a README, a description, a licence and a logo)

- **README explains the project.** Write a README.md of at least 1000 characters: what the project is, who it is for, its live site and where to report issues.

### Silver (it runs: tests in CI, an automatic deploy, a live site and steps to run it)

- **README shows how to run it.** Add a "Run locally" (or Install / Getting started) section to the README with the exact commands in a code block, including how to run the tests.

### Gold (it is looked after: the BLT theme, a contributing guide, recent commits, several contributors and triaged issues)

- **Contributing guide.** Add CONTRIBUTING.md (or a Contributing section in the README): how to set up, test, and open a pull request on git.owaspblt.org, linking the root CONTRIBUTING.md and AI_POLICY.md.

## Notes

- `public/data.js` is hand-written sample data with made-up ambassadors; load real ambassadors and projects (or say clearly that it is a demo).
- Nexus links people to `blt.owasp.org/ambassador`; the main domain is now owaspblt.org, so check that page and update the link.
- The README still points at the old per-project repository (`/BLT/BLT-Nexus`); use https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/tree/main/blt-nexus.
- There is one test (the avatar fallback); add tests for search and filtering.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] README explains the project
- [ ] README shows how to run it
- [ ] Contributing guide
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-nexus` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-nexus
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-nexus
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
